stories.title: Flintshire Council “no longer” has a dog warden, councillors told
stories.summary: A senior officer told councillors there is no dog warden at the council, but the updated enforcement policy still says the Dog Warden will collect strays. Flintshire County Council no longer has a dog warden, a senior officer has told councillors. stories.title: Pensioners warned about fake Winter Fuel Payment texts asking for bank details
stories.summary: Pensioners are being warned about fake Winter Fuel Payment texts as the payments start to arrive. stories.title: What Welsh retailers paid to cut their carbon and energy costs, according to new research
stories.summary: A £15,000 heating system, an £8,000 second-hand electric van and 2,200 solar panels are among the steps Welsh retailers have taken to cut carbon and costs, according to Welsh Government research published today. stories.title: A494 River Dee bridge flood modelling redone after Natural Resources Wales concerns
stories.summary: The flood risk study for the replacement A494 River Dee bridge has been redone after Natural Resources Wales raised concerns about its accuracy. stories.title: Transport for Wales cancels Chester to Liverpool Lime Street services for the day
stories.summary: Trains between Chester and Liverpool Lime Street have been cancelled for the whole of today, Wednesday 11 November. Transport for Wales said services will not run in either direction because of a shortage of its Class 197 trains. The operator said more trains than usual need repairs at the same time.
